grammar.title: Sending texts with 短信
grammar.explanation: 短信 (duǎnxìn) means "text message, SMS" commonly paired with 发 (to send) or 收到 (to receive).

grammar.title: Marking experience with V + 过
grammar.explanation: 过 (guo) right after a verb shows you have had the experience of doing something at some point: 见过 (have met before), 去过 (have been to). Negate with 没 + verb + 过.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yì tiáo duǎnxìn.
sentences.en: I sent you a text message.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào wǒ de duǎnxìn le ma?
sentences.en: Did you receive my text message?

sentences.pinyin: Tā méi huí wǒ de duǎnxìn.
sentences.en: He didn't reply to my text message.
Let's discuss it via text message.
